conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target monthly return around 1.5%. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on stable assets, leading to lower potential drawdowns but also capped upside.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to low single digits.
Maintain modest exposure in MUU and METU.
Trim broad index (SPY) to 20% to address concentration.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets approximately 2.5% monthly growth while prioritizing risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending broad market exposure with select quality names and a small buffer of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU).

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly growth by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-conviction names and leveraged ETFs. Expect higher potential upside but also significantly increased drawdown risk and amplified losses due to leverage and daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) and high-beta single names (CRWD, SNOW).
Trim broad index (SPY) to 20% to reduce concentration.
Significantly increase allocation to income ETF (QQQI) to 30%.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income and capital preservation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets approximately 1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing stability and low drawdown. It shifts away from growth and leverage towards income-generating assets, though NAV can still decline in market downturns.
